༄༅/ /rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi bsnyen yig nyung gsal snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi bsnyen yig nyung gsal snying por dril ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*/ /ma hā gu ru o rgyan rje'i/ /zhabs la btud nas spyi dril gyi/ /sgrub thabs bsnyen yig nyung gsal dbye/ 'di'i dbang thob cing dam tshigs la gnas pa rnams kyis rtsa gsum spyi dril du sgrub pa'i thabs khyad par 'phags pa 'di nyid kyi bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu sogs gza' skar sbyor byed shis pa'i dus khyad par can la/ gtor sgrom du rtsa gsum snang brnyan yod na bkram pa'i mdun sman raka gtor gsum/ mchod pa rnam lnga dang*/ dam can spyi gtor rgyun bzhag bcas bshams/ tho gtor dang dkar bgegs kyang 'du bya/ dgong thun la rgyun gyi mal sa de ma yin pa zhig tu dkar gtor gser skyems bshams/ /ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsreg gtor bkrus/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ bhū mi pā ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pā ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod spyid srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam la/ dkar gtor dang gser skyems mchod/ tho byang 'dzugs nas/ rgyal tho'i mdun mchod gtor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ /rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bu/ /dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod pa dang*/ yo ga ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ

rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam la/ oṃ dhṛṣ+ta raṣ+tā ya swā hā/ oṃ bi ru ḍha kā ya swā hā/ oṃ bi ru pak+ṣā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ tsa turma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā sa mchod/ zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ gong gi sngags bzhi'i mthar/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan bzhugs bya/ gnas 'dir nyin mo sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ rjes mtshams grol dus tho len skabs mchod gtor bshams la byin rlabs gong ltar/ spyan 'dren mi dgos/ gtor ma dang mchod bstod/ phrin bcol mthar/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang sogs nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs nas gshegs gsol bya/ bkra shis gang rigs brjod nas mchod gtor gtsang sar gshegs/ tho blangs nas dben par bzhag go /rgyal tho bzhag ste nang du 'ong nas/ las byang gi rang nyid skad cig gis bla ma drag po'i skur gyur/ sogs nas bgegs gtor byin rlabs nas bka' bsgo'i mthar gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyi brabs/ suṃ bha ni brjod/ srung 'khor mtshams bcad 'don/ de nas rang mal du sdod nas tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ rtsa gsum gsol 'debs/ skyabs sems brgya skor gsog /mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa rdzogs kyi bar gtong*/ phreng ba byin rlabs spyi ltar bya/ bzlas dmigs gsal btab/ rtsa ba'i bzlas pa ci 'gro 'khor sngags gsog mi dgos/ mthar dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya tshar gsum re brjod/ rtsa gsum gtor bsngo 'don/ rjes chog gi mchod bstod bsdu ldangs bsngo smon shis brjod bya/

phyir nangs thor thun la tshig bdun dang rtsa gsum gsol 'debs sogs/ sngar nub bzhin skyabs sems lan gsum mchod pa byin rlabs nas shis brjod bar 'don/ snga thun la gsol 'debs dang*/ skyabs sems/ rang nyid skad cig gi bla ma drag po'i skur gyur/ bgegs gtor bshams mi dgos/ hūm̐/ chos nyid gdod nas sogs las byang shis brjod bar dang*/ phyi thun dang dgong thun la thor thun dang 'dra/ dgong thun la gtor bsngo 'don/ tshes bcu nyer lnga sogs la gtor ma grub nas tshogs dang*/ lhag ma snod gcig tu sgrub pa ma grol bar gsog dgos/ bsang dang gser skyems rgyun du mi dgos/ dus bzang sogs la nges par bya/ rjes chog mchod bstod yig brgya'i mthar/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis tshogs mgron rnams brtan bzhugs bya/ de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas rtsa sngags rab 'bru 'bum/ 'bring 'bum phrag bcu/ tha ma 'bum bzhi kha skong bcas bzla/ rtsa sngags bsnyen tshar rjes rtsa sngags phreng skor re tsam bzla nas/ 'khor sngags rnams re re bzhin grangs gsog 'bum phrag re re'am/ khri bzhi re tsam bzla/ de yang a mā ra ṇi gsog dus gzhan rnams bdun re tsam dang*/ 'og ma gsog dus gong ma rnams bdun re tsam gyis chog /shā sa na stong gcig tsam bzla bas mthus/ rdzogs rim mchog sgrub kyi rnal 'byor kyang ci nus bsgom/ tshe sgrub byed na/ tshe 'brang*/ tshe ril tshe chang bshams/ bzlas dmigs mgor/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe sarba ma hā gu ru maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa dzaḥ zhes dzab khang dbye nas bdag gis bsgoms pa bzhin tshe 'brang lhar mos dgos/ bdag mdun gnyis kar tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi bzlas dmigs gzhung gsal ltar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi ā yu ṣe sogs tshe bsnyen dang*/ thun mthar tshe 'gugs bskul ba ni/ bdag mdun slob dpon snang srid zil gnon thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i phyag g.yon gyi bum thod las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan dang*/

lha mo 'gyogs ma'i sprul pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar spros pas rang gi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang*/ 'byung ba'i dwangs ma/ 'khor 'das kyi bcud dang dge mtshan thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ mdun gyi tshe rdzas rnams la thim pas rdo rje tshe'i bcud len du gyur pa'i mos pa dang*/ mda' dar g.yab la/ hrīḥ 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang nas/ /longs spyod yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i sku/ /'chi med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas/ /sgrub la tshe dbang mchog stsol phyir/ /thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang*/ /phyi snod 'byung ba bzhi yi bcud/ /nang bcud 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dpal/ /gsang ba rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan kun/ /'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus/ /bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la bstims/ /rgas med lang tsho'i dngos grub stsol/ /nad med bde ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ zhes tshe 'gugs bskul/ a/ spros pas srid zhir khyab pa'i tshe/ /bsdus pas thig le nyag gcig klong*/ /'pho 'gyur med par rgyas btab pas/ /ye shes chen po'i srog 'grub shog /dzñān badz+ra rak+ṣa a aḥ de ltar tshe sgrub zhag bdun sogs gang lcogs bya'o/ /sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i do nub nas gtor mchod kha gso/ dkar mngar chang gi sbrus pa'i 'brang rgyas nor gzugs dang*/ bza' btung sna tshogs/ stegs bu khebs ldan 'bru yi g.yung drung bris pa'i khar bzhag /gtor gdugs ser dmar phub/ thor thun la snga bar langs nas gtso 'khor bzlas pa grub nas rtsa bsnyen mthar/

kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ btags pa stong phrag mthar dbyangs gsal/ rten snying sogs dang*/ mchod gtor bsngos/ bsang dang tshogs/ lhag ma'i skabs tshogs lhag bsogs pa rnams bcas phyir mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sogs kyis/ gtor 'bul rgyun bzhag phul/ las byang gi mchod bstod rgyas pa dang*/ ye shes sku mchog gi bshags pa byas nas/ hoḥ rtsa gsum lha tshogs sogs kyis dngos grub blangs/ sgrub rten gtor ma tshe 'brang sogs dang 'brang rgyas rnams gnas gsum gtugs nas rdzas la rol/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ yig brgya ci mang bzla/ bsdu ldangs smon shis dang*/ grub na gtang rag tshogs brgya zhig grub na legs/ mtshams grol rjes gong gsal ltar tho dgrol ba sogs bya'o/ /sbyin sreg grub na legs kyang*/ ma grub tshe nyin kha shas yig brgya bzla bar bya'o/ /'di dges srid gsum 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal las grol o rgyan rjes/ /'bral med thugs rjes bzung ba dang*/ /pad+ma 'od du skye bar shog /rgyun gyi rnam 'byor la skyabs sems mtshams/ mchod pa byin brlabs nas btang*/ bzlas pa'i mjug bsdu ldangs la 'jug pas chog go /zhes pa'ang chos kyi blo gros pas bris pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ bkra shis so//
